mapper.select: SELECT st.id AS send_target_id, st.send_history_id, st.customer_id, st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, ch.channel_type, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone FROM send_target st JOIN customer c ON c.id = st.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = st.final_channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.id = #{sendTargetId} AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reject_history WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reject_history ( customer_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_channel_consent ccc SET ccc.is_consented = 0, ccc.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, ccc.updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE ccc.customer_id = #{customerId} AND NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ccc.channel_id IN ( SELECT ch.id FROM channel ch WHERE NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ch.channel_type IN ('SMS', 'LMS') )
